keywords: EIP-8141 外层交易加入签名列表以支持后量子签名聚合
VERIFY frame 可调用预编译
多数 ZK 并不 ZK
summary: lightclient 提议在 EIP-8141 外层交易加入 signatures 字段，为体积庞大的后量子签名聚合做前向兼容。derekchiang 提议让合约账户的 VERIFY frame 也能用预编译验证。L2BEAT 指出其 ZK 目录中多数证明系统并不具备零知识性质。

items.topic: 原生 AA：EIP-8141 签名与验证
items.title: EIP-8141：外层交易加入签名列表
items.note: （lightclient）提交：8141 的重要目标是对签名聚合前向兼容，后量子签名体积大，大量用户迁移时聚合可能非常关键，因此在外层交易对象新增 signatures 字段。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: add a signatures list to the outer tx
items.note_en: (lightclient), submitted: a key goal of 8141 is forward compatibility with signature aggregation, which may become crucial as many users migrate to large post-quantum signatures, so a signatures field is added to the outer transaction object.
items.topic_en: Native AA: EIP-8141 signatures and verification

items.topic: 原生 AA：EIP-8141 签名与验证
items.title: EIP-8141：允许 VERIFY frame 使用预编译
items.note: （derekchiang）提交：此前只有 EOA 默认代码支持，更新后 EOA 与合约账户可共用同一逻辑。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: allow using precompiles for VERIFY frames
items.note_en: (derekchiang), submitted: previously only the EOA default code could, and the update lets EOAs and contract accounts share the same logic.
items.topic_en: Native AA: EIP-8141 signatures and verification

keywords_en: EIP-8141 adds a signatures list to the outer transaction for PQ signature aggregation
summary_en: lightclient proposed a signatures field on EIP-8141's outer transaction for forward compatibility with aggregation of large post-quantum signatures. derekchiang proposed letting contract accounts' VERIFY frames use precompiles for verification. L2BEAT noted that most proving systems in its ZK Catalog lack the zero knowledge property.
